title: AndroidAPS seems to sleep starting at 3 am
symptom: AndroidAPS appears to sleep starting at 3 am, with no activity in the log between around 3 am and the time the app was clicked in the morning, despite background execution permission being granted.
cause: Google Play Protect is shutting down AndroidAPS because it does not recognize the app.
fix: Stop Google Play Protect in Play Store. Also check for cleaning apps or battery optimization, but Play Protect is the most probable cause.
evidence_quote: Tell him/her to stop Google Play Protect in Play Store. As it doesn't "know" AAPS, it is shutting it down.
